eatsafety.tagline: Never guess again. Always eat safely.
eatsafety.summary: A personal allergen traffic light, AI weekly meal plans and a food checker for living with intolerances.
description: Gluten, lactose, fructose, histamine, sorbitol – or simply: your body reacts, and sometimes you don't even know exactly why. EatSafety makes every meal a pleasure again – instead of a research project.
You set up your personal allergen traffic light, and the AI plans, checks and rewrites recipes using only what you can tolerate – seasonal, regional and reimagined every day.
For everyone who doesn't want to fight their intolerances, but simply live with them. Because food should bring joy – not anxiety.

features.title: Allergen traffic light
features.text: Rate every problematic ingredient: 🔴 off-limits, 🟡 small amounts only, 🟢 fine – including personal notes the AI understands.

features.title: AI weekly plan
features.text: A complete plan for breakfast, lunch and dinner – built exclusively from what you can tolerate. Seasonal and regional.

features.title: Food checker
features.text: Scan a barcode, photograph an ingredient list, or type it in – an instant result against your personal exclusion list.

features.title: Leftover ideas
features.text: Type or speak what's still in your fridge – and get a creative, gut-friendly recipe in seconds.

features.title: Recipe transformer
features.text: Paste a URL or recipe text – EatSafety rewrites any recipe for your intolerances. Swapped ingredients are marked.

features.title: Shopping list & favorites
features.text: Ingredients move from the weekly plan to your list with one tap. Check off, export as PDF, save favorite recipes.

pricing.note: Start for free. Upgrade if you need more.

wefixit.tagline: Your smart mechanic, right in your pocket.
wefixit.summary: OBD2 diagnostics, an AI mechanic and repair guides – so you know exactly what's going on with your car.
description: No more expensive workshop visits without a plan. WeFixIt connects your phone via Bluetooth to your OBD2 adapter and reads every stored fault code in seconds – free, with no waiting.
Then let the AI take over: Toni, your personal AI mechanic, answers questions, interprets fault codes and delivers step-by-step repair guides with a tool list and cost estimate.

For anyone who doesn't want to walk into a workshop blind – for tinkerers, budget-conscious drivers, and anyone who wants to understand their car better. Because you have the right to know what's going on with it.

features.title: OBD2 diagnostics
features.text: Read and clear every stored fault code via Bluetooth – in seconds, no workshop, no waiting.

features.title: Ask Toni!
features.text: Your round-the-clock AI mechanic. Send a question, a photo, or a fault code – and get precise answers about your car.

features.title: AI diagnosis
features.text: From fault code to fix: a clear explanation, likely causes, costs, difficulty level and repair guide.

features.title: Live data
features.text: Engine temperature, RPM, lambda values and more in real time – straight from the ECU, refreshed every 500 ms.

features.title: Maintenance planner
features.text: Reminders by date or mileage, store receipts and photos, export as PDF or CSV – recurring schedules set automatically.

features.title: Cost tracking
features.text: Fuel with consumption calculations, insurance, workshop visits and more – clear charts show what your car really costs.

free: 6 AI requests per week – renews automatically
premium: Lifetime unlock – pay once, use forever
pricing.note: Start for free. Upgrade if you need more.

nook.tagline: Your AI travel companion – no tourist traps.
nook.summary: AI trip planner, live crowd indicator and automatic audio guides – explore cities like a local, not like a tourist.
description: Discover cities the way they're meant to feel – no crowds, no tourist traps, no rigid routes. NOOK is your intelligent, invisible travel companion: it plans, guides and accompanies you like a local friend.

Tell NOOK where you're going, how long you're staying and what you love – and the AI builds a personalized day plan with optimized routes in seconds. On location, the live crowd indicator shows at a glance which places are calm and which are packed, and your audio guide starts automatically the moment you approach a sight.
NOOK never books on its own and never decides without you – the AI suggests, you stay in control. All location data is anonymized, GDPR-compliant, and everything works offline.

features.title: AI day planner
features.text: Tailor-made itineraries in seconds – with optimized routes, schedules and hotel recommendations right along your path. Plan together and vote on stops democratically.

features.title: Live crowd indicator
features.text: Real-time occupancy for every sight: green means relaxed exploring, red means NOOK knows a quieter alternative. Includes a crowd alert before you end up in the thick of it.

features.title: Automatic audio guide
features.text: Step within 50 meters of a sight and your personal audio guide starts by itself. Professional voices in 7 languages, fully available offline.

features.title: Smart scanner
features.text: Point your camera at a menu – NOOK instantly warns you about hidden fees, inflated prices and the infamous “coperto”. Output in your language.

features.title: Transit assistant
features.text: The fastest local connections plus direct links to official tickets – no more guesswork in unfamiliar transit networks.

features.title: Explorer stamp book
features.text: Every sight you visit leaves a GPS-validated stamp. Unlock badges and build your digital travel journal.

free: AI itineraries & map with live crowd indicator
Save everything offline – no roaming needed
pricing.note: Start for free. Go premium when you want to dive deeper.

cocos-world.tagline: Language learning for kids – playful, with CoCo.
cocos-world.summary: A child-friendly language app with five learning worlds, AI pronunciation training and bonus mini-games – learning Turkish as an adventure.
description: Is your child growing up bilingual, or about to discover a new language? CoCo's World turns learning Turkish into a grand adventure: with CoCo, the lovable animated mascot, kids explore five colorful worlds – from CoCo's house to the Istanbul adventure.

The learning path leads step by step from vocabulary to real sentences to pronunciation: your child speaks, the AI gives instant feedback – and in free conversation mode, CoCo even chats with your child in Turkish. After every completed world, bonus mini-games await as a reward.

Made for parents: no ads, a time-limit feature, no account needed for basic access, and voice recordings are never stored permanently. Suitable from age 3 with a parent, independently up to around age 10.

features.title: Five learning worlds
features.text: CoCo's house, the garden, the city, the zoo and the Istanbul adventure – each world brings new vocabulary, sentences and its own bonus mini-game on a growing world map.

features.title: Pronunciation AI
features.text: Your child repeats after CoCo, the app analyzes the pronunciation with AI and gives instant, encouraging feedback – with a natural Turkish voice.

features.title: Free conversation mode
features.text: CoCo holds real little conversations in Turkish – reacting, speaking and praising like a patient learning buddy.

features.title: SuffixPuzzle & games
features.text: Turkish endings (agglutination) explained as a child-friendly puzzle, plus ObjectSearch, SkateRunner, FruitCatch, FlappyCoCo and more.

features.title: Stars, coins & streaks
features.text: Stars for completed lessons, coins to unlock new worlds and a growing plant that shows overall progress.

features.title: Made for parents
features.text: No ads, a time-limit feature, the microphone is used only for pronunciation practice, and no account is needed for basic access. PEGI 3.

free: First learning world with vocabulary, sentences & a mini-game
premium: All five learning worlds & bonus mini-games
AI pronunciation training & free conversation mode
Full progress with stars, coins & streaks
pricing.note: Start for free – a pure learning experience without ads.

werkflow.tagline: From photo to quote, from quote to e-invoice.
werkflow.summary: The app for tradespeople: photograph the job site, describe the job by voice – the AI writes the quote, one tap turns it into the invoice.
description: No more paperwork in the evening: photograph the job site, describe the job by voice – and the AI turns it into a complete, professional quote as a PDF. Right on site, in a few minutes. Once the customer accepts, one tap turns the quote into the invoice.

Werkflow was built for tradespeople, installers and small businesses across all trades – electricians, painters, plumbers, carpenters or roofers. The app works out advance, final and cancellation invoices for you, and every invoice carries a ZUGFeRD or XRechnung e-invoice that DATEV, Lexware and similar tools read in directly.

Built for the tax office, too: Werkflow archives sent quotes and invoices unalterably and with a change log, as the German GoBD rules require. For your tax advisor there is an export as a ZIP archive and a DATEV booking batch. Your data is stored on servers in the EU.

features.title: AI photo analysis
features.text: Photograph the job site or damaged area – the AI recognizes the required materials and work steps and suggests matching quote line items.

features.title: Speak instead of type
features.text: Briefly describe the job by voice – the AI turns it into structured line items. Dictate text in quotes, invoices and notes, even with dirty hands.

features.title: From quote to invoice
features.text: One tap turns the accepted quote into the invoice: sequential number, every mandatory detail under German VAT law, plus advance, final and cancellation invoices.

features.title: E-invoicing included
features.text: Every invoice as a PDF with an embedded e-invoice (ZUGFeRD / Factur-X), or as XRechnung for public-sector clients – ready for DATEV, Lexware and more.

features.title: GoBD archive and tax advisor export
features.text: Sent documents stay unalterable and every change is logged. The export delivers a ZIP archive and a DATEV booking batch, plus a template for the process documentation.

features.title: Enter once, use everywhere
features.text: Store company details, logo, bank details, signature and customers once. Your materials catalog with prices feeds into every AI calculation automatically.

free: 3 free AI quotes, full feature set
No credit card, nothing to cancel
premium: Small business: 50 AI quotes per month
Every plan: unlimited invoices, advance and cancellation invoices, e-invoicing included
pricing.note: Monthly subscription via Google Play, cancel any month. Plans differ only in the number of AI quotes.

shrinkit.tagline: Big files, made small – no upload, no subscription.
shrinkit.summary: Shrink photos, videos and audio – entirely on your device, with a size preview before you save.
description: Your storage is full, and every new photo, video and song makes it worse. ShrinkIt makes big files small – right on your device.

No sign-up, no account, no cloud. Your files never leave your device – because ShrinkIt has no server to send them to. Compression runs on your device's own codecs and works without an internet connection.
And you see how big the file will be before you save it – measured, not guessed. Originals are only removed if you explicitly confirm it.

features.title: Photos with a size preview
features.text: JPG, PNG and WebP. Pick a quality level and see the resulting size before saving – or set a target size directly.

features.title: Videos in three levels
features.text: MP4, MOV and AVI. Three quality levels for the quick route, with live progress you can cancel at any time.

features.title: Audio with real controls
features.text: MP3, M4A, WAV and AAC. Set bitrate, sample rate and mono/stereo yourself – instead of a single slider.

features.title: Choose your output format
features.text: M4A sounds better at the same bitrate. MP3 plays on virtually any device and keeps track details and cover art.

features.title: Several files at once
features.text: Process multiple files in one run. The history keeps photos, videos and audio apart – open, share, save to your gallery or delete.

features.title: Genuinely local
features.text: Nothing is uploaded, nothing analysed, nothing passed to third parties. Shrinking works just the same with no connection at all.

premium: No size limit on individual images
pricing.note: One-time purchase – no subscription, no recurring costs.

shots: Editor: target size and output format

fabula.tagline: Audio stories where your child plays the lead.
fabula.summary: Invent your own characters, pick a story world, have it read aloud – every story is new.
description: Fabula turns your child into the hero of their own story – and then reads it to them. You invent a character together, pick a story world, and moments later a brand-new audio story is ready. No two stories are alike.

Characters get a name, an age and a look – lead and supporting roles, as many as you like. They stay saved and can appear again and again. Add one of ten story worlds and, if you want, a few keywords: a lost teddy, a trip to the dentist, the first day of school. Whatever is on your minds becomes the story.

Stories and voices are created with artificial intelligence (Google Gemini). That means every story really is new – and occasionally surprising. Fabula needs an account and an internet connection for this; downloaded stories then play offline. For children aged 6 and up, together with their parents.

features.title: Your child is the main character
features.text: Name, age, appearance – lead and supporting characters, as many as you like. They stay saved and return in every new story.

features.title: Ten story worlds
features.text: Adventure, fantasy, animals, bedtime, friendship, detective, fairy tale, comedy, nature or learning. A few keywords turn it into precisely your story.

features.title: Nine voices, six languages
features.text: Warm, lively, calm or strong – you pick the favourite. German, English, Spanish, French, Italian and Portuguese, ideal for multilingual families.

features.title: Built for falling asleep
features.text: The sleep timer lets the story fade out on its own. Reading speed is adjustable, chapters play on automatically – and favourite characters can carry on into a new chapter.

features.title: Listen offline, read along
features.text: Download stories for the car, the train or the holiday house – over Wi-Fi only if you prefer. The text sits alongside for reading along, at whatever size suits.

features.title: Made for parents
features.text: A parent PIN protects settings, purchases and the parent area. No ads, no ad networks. And any story can be reported with a single tap – we look at every report.

premium: Buy story credit whenever you need it
Credit never expires and stays with the account
Nothing is deducted until the story is finished
pricing.note: No subscription, no monthly cost – you buy credit only when a new story is meant to appear.
